finding_summary: Identical to train_offline_live_scale.py (same config/env/run_mc call) but wraps oranslice_drl.drl_policy.DQNPolicy.train_step() (frozen, byte-unedited) to capture the loss/grad_norm/epsilon/avg_target_q it already computes and returns but mc_runner never logs. Same non-invasive technique M41 used for send_control(). Verified via a 3-episode smoke test: recovered epsilon values matched the documented closed-form decay recursion exactly (1.0*0.985^2=0.970225 after 2 episodes).

Trained DQN-QoE and DQN-SLA under experiments/configs/m46/saclb_m46_train.yaml (MR1 output), matched on reward-mode only: same 300 episodes, same 6-seed set (256-261, reusing Stage10/12's own established seed convention for this pipeline, not invented), same ClosedLoopKpmSource env, same Table I hyperparameters. cwd=framework/ + absolute paths per this project's own documented near-miss fix (run_offline_v2_reverify.sh). All 12 runs completed cleanly in ~12 min wall-clock; 12/12 checkpoints + 12/12 diagnostics files confirmed written by the sweep's own per-run existence check.

Computed per-run Q1-vs-Q4 and decile-level reward shape, Q1-vs-Q4 loss (by train_step call order), final epsilon, and distinct live max_ratio values visited per slice. Finding, reported honestly not smoothed: reward does NOT improve Q1->Q4 in any of 12 runs (consistent sharp early drop, episodes ~1-90, then a plateau in 10/12 runs; 2 seeds, qoe/259 and sla/259, show a later continued decline instead); loss grows rather than shrinks in all 12 runs (consistent with ordinary DQN TD-loss mechanics tracking bootstrapped target magnitude/variance, not an accuracy metric). Epsilon correctly decays to its documented 0.05 floor in all 12 runs.

12/12 runs (both reward modes, all 6 seeds): urllc's live max_ratio visits exactly {6,7,8} and embb's visits exactly {5,6,7,8,9,10} -- an exact match to MR1's configured full range, zero exceptions. mmtc's max_ratio stays fixed at {5} in all 12 runs, confirming the fixed-slice design held under real 300-episode training, not just the earlier smoke test. No collapse to a static ceiling in any run.

GATE MR2 item (2) (full action-range exercise, not collapsed to a static ceiling) is a clean, unambiguous PASS in all 12 runs -- the criterion this gate's own framing treats as decisive. Item (1) (classic reward/loss convergence) is reported honestly as NOT observed -- an early-drop-then-plateau reward shape and growing loss, matched across nearly all seeds in both arms, with a plausible but explicitly-flagged-as-interpretation mechanism (MR1's action space is confined entirely within an already-congested band, leaving no easily learnable 'safe' action to converge toward). Per the milestone's own instruction, this offline pattern is NOT interpreted as a QoE-vs-SLA verdict (common to both arms) or as evidence of live behavior (Stage 12: zero offline/live correlation for this architecture). Checkpoint/config/seed provenance for MR3 recorded in the doc. GATE MR2 reported -- awaiting go before MR3 (live revalidation, the actual trust gate).
